interpretation: The runner flag source_was_committed=false is preserved and correct for the complete hashed input set, because that set includes one ignored, untracked build-provenance JSON. The tracked regular inputs are independently verified against commit 34c5526ff87ec1208a88f8c86c806fde39505737; the additional metadata is identified by its own SHA-256. This supplement does not replace the runner report or turn its false flag into true.
scope: Read-only binding of each tracked regular file included in the existing runner source-before manifest to the exact Git commit, plus the separately hashed ignored build-provenance input.

separately_hashed_build_metadata.role: Generated local NDU bridge build provenance. It records the built bridge binary identity, upstream commit, toolchain identities and build-input hashes; it is an additional hashed run input, not a Git-committed source file.
